{
  "objective": "Prepare and serve room-service orders at The Evanstonian.",
  "trigger": "A guest calls room service at The Evanstonian",
  "owner_and_participants": {
    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "Room-service manager",
      "Sommelier (wine waiter)",
      "Waiter"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "Guest's room number",
    "Order details: food, wine, other alcoholic beverages, and non-alcoholic drinks",
    "Cart contents"
  ],
  "systems_involved": [],
  "current_process": [
    "A guest calls room service at The Evanstonian",
    "The room-service manager takes down the order",
    "She submits an order ticket to the kitchen to begin preparing the food",
    "She gives an order to the sommelier to fetch wine from the cellar and to prepare any other alcoholic beverages",
    "Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or some other alcoholic beverage",
    "The manager assigns the order to the waiter",
    "While the kitchen and the sommelier are doing their tasks, the waiter readsies a cart (puts a tablecloth on the cart and gathers silverware)",
    "The waiter is also responsible for nonalcoholic drinks",
    "Once the food, wine, and cart are ready, the waiter delivers it to the guest's room",
    "After returning to the room-service station, the waiter debits the guest's account"
  ],
  "bottlenecks_and_risks": [
    "Wine fetching depends entirely on the sommelier, who works alone during the preparation period, so there is no backup when the sommelier is busy",
    "Orders without wine require the same effort but receive no benefit, which means the kitchen prepares food for nothing",
    "Waiting to bill until after delivery increases the time between ordering and consumption by about two hours",
    "The waiter can hold orders while waiting for wine, so the kitchen does not always have enough work to keep staff occupied",
    "No one owns the process, so nobody is accountable for its inefficiency"
  ],
  "recommended_improved_process": [
    "Assign room-service orders to a named waiter per guest, not just by room",
    "Give the waiter a list of wines available for the day before they go out, so they know what to fetch",
    "Set a minimum wine requirement per order so the kitchen has something to prepare",
    "Require the waiter to complete the order first before the kitchen starts",
    "Bill the guest immediately upon arrival, reducing the holding time",
    "Review wine usage against menu items and adjust the wine list accordingly"
  ],
  "ai_agent_steps": [
    "An AI agent can generate the wine list for the day based on menu items and current stock",
    "An AI agent can issue the wine-fetching task to the sommelier queue, relieving the manager",
    "An AI agent can flag orders missing wine requirements and prompt the waiter to complete them",
    "An AI agent can track wine usage against menu items and suggest changes to the list"
  ],
  "human_approvals_controls": [
    "The room-service manager approves the wine list and wine requirements before it goes live",
    "The waiter completes the order before the kitchen begins preparation",
    "Billing is done automatically once the order arrives, requiring no further action",
    "Any change to the wine list requires approval through the management channel"
  ]
}

{
  "objective": "Select and sell a company's initial public offering (IPO), which involves preparing and filing a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), checking compliance with state blue-sky laws, arranging a roadshow to raise capital, fixing the issue price immediately after SEC clearance, entering into a firm commitment to buy the stock, and selling the shares to the public.",
  "trigger": "A company decides to go public by selecting the underwriters",
  "owner_and_participants": {
    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "Underwriters, who perform the three roles described above",
      "The company being sold",
      "Potential investors"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "The company's financial statements and other documents required by the registration statement",
    "State blue-sky law requirements",
    "Roadshow presentations to potential investors"
  ],
  "systems_involved": [],
  "current_process": [
    "A company decides to go public and selects the underwriters",
    "Underwriters prepare and file a registration statement with the SEC",
    "They check that the issue complies with state blue-sky laws in each state",
    "While the registration statement awaits SEC approval, underwriters arrange a roadshow to talk to potential investors",
    "Immediately after receiving SEC clearance, underwriters fix the issue price",
    "After the price is fixed, they enter into a firm commitment to buy the stock",
    "Finally, they offer the stock to the public when they have not yet found any reason not to do it"
  ],
  "bottlenecks_and_risks": [
    "The underwriter's reputation depends on presenting fair facts, so the selection process requires the company to prove itself before the underwriter agrees to take it on",
    "Blue-sky law compliance checks require research across many states, which can be time-consuming and expensive",
    "Fixing the issue price immediately after SEC clearance means the underwriter commits to a price without knowing whether demand will meet it",
    "Finding no reason not to sell does not mean the investment is good; the underwriter has already committed to buying at that price",
    "The entire IPO process takes place behind closed doors between the company and the underwriter, with no investor feedback loop"
  ],
  "recommended_improved_process": [
    "Publish a prospectus package containing all material information about the company and the proposed issue",
    "Engage an independent registered public accounting firm to review the financials and report on fairness",
    "Obtain a written opinion from counsel stating the issuer has made a fair presentation of the facts",
    "File the registration statement with the SEC and publish it online for public inspection",
    "Hold a pre-IPO roadshow with targeted investor groups before submitting the application",
    "Review the application against state blue-sky laws during the submission stage",
    "Release the price once the application has been approved and the prospectus filed"
  ],
  "ai_agent_steps": [
    "An AI agent can draft the prospectus package incorporating the fairness review and the opinion of counsel",
    "An AI agent can flag sections of the application requiring further investigation due to red flags such as incomplete disclosures or unreviewed financials",
    "An AI agent can monitor state filings and alert the team when the issuer falls outside the permitted scope of the application",
    "An AI agent can produce the preliminary pricing deck based on market feedback received during the roadshow"
  ],
  "human_approvals_controls": [
    "The CEO approves the final prospectus and the application before it is submitted",
    "Counsel reviews the fairness opinion and signs off on it before the application is filed",
    "The underwriter's board approves the price before it is announced",
    "Any change to the application requires re-submission to the SEC"
  ]
}

{
  "objective": "Report meter operation applications to the GO and register meters for use.",
  "trigger": "A meter operation application is submitted to the GO.",
  "owner_and_participants": {
    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "MPON (Meter Operation Office)",
      "MPOO (Metering Point of Sale)",
      "MSPO (Metering System Point of Sale)",
      "SP (Service Provider)"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "Meter operation application",
    "Registration confirmation from the GO"
  ],
  "systems_involved": [],
  "current_process": [
    "A meter operation application is submitted to the GO",
    "The GO examines the application of the MPON",
    "The GO rejects the application of the MPON or confirms its application",
    "The GO informs the MPOO and the MSPO about the registration confirmation of the MPON",
    "The MPON and the MPOO acquire or change equipment",
    "The MPON informs the GO when the entire process fails or succeeds",
    "The GO confirms the failure of the assignment to the MPON or assigns the MPON on receipt of a message",
    "The GO informs the MPOO and the MSPO of the assignment of the MPON",
    "The GO informs the SP about the assignment of the MPON"
  ],
  "bottlenecks_and_risks": [
    "There is no owner identified for the process, so nobody owns whether the application was rejected or confirmed, which means nothing can be closed until someone decides",
    "The GO's decision to reject or confirm depends entirely on examination of the application, without any evidence or reason given, so there is no record of why something failed",
    "Equipment acquisition and changes happen independently of the GO's approval, so the system cannot tell whether the work has been done",
    "Messages sent between parties have no defined format or content, so the GO cannot tell whether the MPON received them",
    "Failure to receive a message within a set time triggers a confirmatory rejection, but the GO does not know whether the MPON never received anything at all",
    "Assignments depend solely on messages arriving, so the GO cannot assign a MPON who has never communicated",
    "No one records the outcome of the whole process, so the status of an application cannot be determined once it leaves the GO"
  ],
  "recommended_improved_process": [
    "Name an accountable owner for each meter operation application",
    "Record the GO's decision to reject or confirm against a reason code, so failures can be resolved automatically",
    "Require a registered email address for the MPON before processing starts",
    "Send a standardised confirmation message containing the GO's action and expected response",
    "Log equipment acquisition and changes against the application record",
    "Set a timeout period during which the GO will re-examine the application before rejecting outright",
    "Publish the outcome of the entire process so the status of an application can be determined outside GO hours"
  ],
  "ai_agent_steps": [
    "An AI agent can send the GO the recorded GO decision and the required action, such as a reply or payment",
    "An AI agent can monitor the timeout period and flag applications due for re-examination",
    "An AI agent can log equipment acquisition and changes against the application record and report on outstanding assignments",
    "An AI agent can produce the published outcome status listing for customers"
  ],
  "human_approvals_controls": [
    "The accountable owner approves the recorded GO decision before it is released to the customer",
    "The GO reviews and releases the automated re-examination reminders before they expire",
    "Any assignment made by the GO requires the accountable owner's authorisation",
    "The GO resolves disputed outcomes through a formal appeal procedure"
  ]
}

{
  "objective": "Handle customer complaints about deteriorating telecommunications service and escalate them through a defined process.",
  "trigger": "The customer perceives that her subscribed service has degraded.",
  "owner_and_participants": {
    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "Customer Service employees",
      "Service Management",
      "Resource Provisioning",
      "Billing & Collections"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "Problem parameters received from the customer",
    "Contractual SLAs",
    "Prioritized action items derived from the problem report",
    "Information collected during the history of the contractual relationship"
  ],
  "systems_involved": [
    "System T (problem reporting)",
    "Electronic service determining customer significance",
    "Service Management investigating quality issues",
    "Resource Provisioning performing analysis and creating trouble reports"
  ],
  "current_process": [
    "A customer complains that her service has degraded and a list of problem parameters is sent to Customer Service",
    "An employee enters the problem report into System T",
    "The problem report is compared to the customer's SLA to determine the extent and detail of the service degradation",
    "Based on this, the necessary countermeasures are determined, including their respective priorities",
    "An electronic service determines the significance of the customer based on historical contract data",
    "In cases involving a premium customer, an extra problem-fix process links to it",
    "If the customer is significant enough to require a different course of action, the process returns to re-prioritizing previous decisions",
    "Taking together the information, a detailed problem report is created",
    "The detailed problem report is sent to Service Management",
    "Service Management investigates whether the problem is analyzable at the departmental level or whether it may lie outside their own domain",
    "If Service Management assesses the problem to be not analyzable, the detailed problem report is sent to Resource Provisioning",
    "When Resource Provisioning receives the detailed problem report, it checks for possible problems and creates a trouble report indicating the type of problem",
    "Either trouble report or the normal service-execution notification is included in a status report and sent back to Service Management",
    "Service Management prepares the final status report based on the received information",
    "For the case that no problem was detected at all, the actual service performance is sent back to Customer Service",
    "For the case that minor corrective actions are required, Service Management undertakes them themselves",
    "After sending, this process path of Service Management ends",
    "For the case that automatic resource restoration is required, Service Management creates a request for automatic resource restoration and sends it to Resource Provisioning",
    "Resource Provisioning tracks any possible errors and undertakes the necessary corrective actions before a trouble-shooting report is created",
    "This trouble-shooting report is sent to Service Management and forms part of the problem resolution report",
    "The trouble-shooting report is sent to Billing & Collections so they can adjust the billing"
  ],
  "bottlenecks_and_risks": [
    "No owner is specified in input, so nobody owns the escalation path and its completion",
    "The same problem can be escalated twice - once to Service Management and again to Resource Provisioning - because the trigger is the same parameter set",
    "The determination of customer significance depends entirely on historical contract data, which does not exist for some customers",
    "Automatic resource restoration requires a hold-and-wait period of up to two days, and termination occurs without further processing when the hold expires",
    "There is no defined exit point for the customer once the problem is resolved, so the loop repeats indefinitely",
    "The entire process relies on the accuracy of the initial complaint record, which is entered manually and cannot be verified against the customer's experience"
  ],
  "recommended_improved_process": [
    "Assign a named escalation owner per customer group and define the escalation path and exit criteria",
    "Build a customer profile containing recorded experiences and SLA commitments across contracts, not just historical data",
    "Route complaints automatically to the correct escalation path using a machine-learning model trained on past records",
    "Define a defined exit condition for each customer group such as a service improvement target or a refund threshold",
    "Release the hold on automatic resource restoration requests immediately after the status report is issued",
    "Report monthly on escalations, recovery time and cost"
  ],
  "ai_agent_steps": [
    "An AI agent can route incoming complaints automatically to the appropriate escalation path based on the complaint content and the customer profile",
    "An AI agent can flag complaints showing a decline in service performance towards the defined exit condition",
    "An AI agent can produce the monthly escalations, recovery time and cost report from the captured data",
    "An AI agent can track the progress of resource restoration requests and notify when the hold expires"
  ],
  "human_approvals_controls": [
    "Escalation to Service Management requires approval above a defined threshold",
    "Any decision to terminate the process due to a held-resource request exceeding the hold period requires the manager's approval",
    "The customer is notified of the exit condition and given a defined timeframe to resolve the issue",
    "A person reviews and signs off the monthly escalations, recovery time and cost report"
  ]
}

{
  "objective": "Win and execute a power supplier switch for customers.",
  "trigger": "A switch-over request is submitted by a customer.",
  "owner_and_participants": {
    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "Customer service (Sales and Distribution)",
      "Grid operators"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "Customer data transmitted from the customer",
    "Contract documents generated from the customer data",
    "Metering data collected on the switch-date"
  ],
  "systems_involved": [
    "CRM (customer data entry and comparison)",
    "CIS (contract documents and automated checks)",
    "Customer information system (meter data import)",
    "Power supplier sales agreements"
  ],
  "current_process": [
    "A customer submits a switch-over request, transmitting his data to the customer service center",
    "Customer service receives the data and enters it into the CRM system as a customer data object",
    "Data is compared against the internal customer database for completeness and plausibility",
    "Where errors are found they are corrected using a simple error list",
    "If the customer does not exist in the database a new customer record is created, consisting of name, address and power-gauge",
    "The generated customer record is combined with other customer data to produce the contract documents for the power supplier switch",
    "An automated CIS check confirms the contract documents were successfully generated",
    "In case of a negative response, the causes are analyzed and resolved before re-generation",
    "Once confirmed, a contract is created in the CIS and sent to the customer",
    "A request to the grid operator is automatically sent asking whether the customer may continue to be supplied by the selected supplier",
    "On the switch-date, the grid operator transmits the meter data and final billing to both parties",
    "For the customer and the grid operator the process ends then"
  ],
  "bottlenecks_and_risks": [
    "Switching takes place without a formal written contract, so the relationship between the customer and the old supplier remains unresolved until the switch is completed",
    "The contract is generated from incomplete or incorrect customer data, so the outcome depends entirely on the quality of the initial submission",
    "Receiving meter data late means the customer cannot use the electricity while the switch is running",
    "Supplier concurrence requires the grid operator to transmit a response comment, which is not always received",
    "There is no defined exit path when the grid operator objects to the switch, so switching stops abruptly with no resolution",
    "The 7-day rule applies only to withdrawal, so the customer can still reject the switch even after the meter readings have been taken"
  ],
  "recommended_improved_process": [
    "Generate a written contract from complete customer data before the switch, rather than relying on incomplete data",
    "Capture supplier consent explicitly at the point of switch-off, not implicitly through the grid operator's response",
    "Send the customer a signed copy of the contract immediately after it is agreed, rather than waiting for the switch-date",
    "Set a defined exit path for the old supplier when the grid operator objects, including resolving the conflict",
    "Review switch outcomes quarterly against target conversion rates and customer satisfaction",
    "Report monthly on switch volume, completion rate and reasons for non-conversion"
  ],
  "ai_agent_steps": [
    "An AI agent can generate the contract proposal from the customer data and flag missing fields or inconsistent data",
    "An AI agent can compare incoming switch requests against existing records and flag potential duplicates or gaps",
    "An AI agent can analyze the grid operator's response comments and flag likely cause-and-effect relationships",
    "An AI agent can draft the signed contract and send it to the customer upon agreement",
    "An AI agent can monitor switch-outcomes against the defined exit path and escalate flagged cases"
  ],
  "human_approvals_controls": [
    "A person reviews and signs off the contract proposal before it is issued to the customer",
    "The grid operator's response comment is reviewed and acted on by a person before the switch proceeds",
    "Any change to the proposed terms requires approval before the contract is released",
    "The customer is given 7 days to withdraw from the switch before it is considered accepted"
  ]
}

{
  "objective": "Process mail received at the registry office.",
  "trigger": "Mail arrives at the registry office.",
  "owner_and_participants": {
    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "The Mail Processing Unit",
      "The Mail Clerk",
      "The Assistant Registry Manager",
      "The Cashier"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "Requisition explaining the reason for rejection when mail is not compliant",
    "Party Details captured by the Cashier",
    "Copied documents printed by the Cashier"
  ],
  "systems_involved": [],
  "current_process": [
    "Mail is collected on a daily basis by the Mail Processing Unit",
    "Within the unit, the Mail Clerk sorts the unopened mail into the various business areas",
    "The mail is distributed",
    "When received by the Registry, mail is opened and sorted into groups for distribution, and thus registered in a manual incoming Mail Register",
    "The Assistant Registry Manager performs a quality check and compiles a list of requisitions explaining the reason for rejection",
    "If mail is not compliant, the matter details are captured and sent back to the party",
    "Otherwise, the matter details are captured and provided to the Cashier, who takes the applicable fees attached to the mail",
    "At this point, the Assistant Registry Manager puts the receipt and copied documents into an envelope and posts it to the party"
  ],
  "bottlenecks_and_risks": [
    "Manual sorting means mail cannot be routed automatically according to its destination, so the same piece of mail can end up in different areas depending on which clerk handles it first",
    "A quality check performed by one person against a register does not guarantee compliance across all mail streams",
    "Requisitions explaining reasons for rejection are compiled manually and sent back to the party, so the cause of non-compliance is never established",
    "Paper receipts and copied documents are put into envelopes before posting, so there is no record of what was posted",
    "The Cashier captures Party Details and prints the Physical Court File after the post has been completed, so the file is incomplete until the last step",
    "There is no defined route through the system once mail leaves the Registry, so the party receives nothing actionable"
  ],
  "recommended_improved_process": [
    "Route mail automatically to the correct area using a classification code applied during collection",
    "Capture matter details directly from the mail itself, such as type of action, without requiring a requisition",
    "Generate a compliance report showing each stream of mail flagged for review and the outcome",
    "Send the party a response confirming receipt and the next step, rather than a paper requisition",
    "Print the Physical Court File electronically immediately after posting, capturing the party's consent",
    "Close the case automatically after payment, removing the need for the Cashier to complete the file afterwards"
  ],
  "ai_agent_steps": [
    "An AI agent can classify mail arriving at the Registry into categories based on the classification code applied during collection",
    "An AI agent can generate the compliance report from flagged mail streams and flag items needing further investigation",
    "An AI agent can send the party a confirmation message with the next step instead of a paper requisition",
    "An AI agent can print the Physical Court File from electronic records after posting, capturing the party's consent"
  ],
  "human_approvals_controls": [
    "The Assistant Registry Manager reviews and approves the compliance report before it is issued to the party",
    "Any item flagged for further investigation requires approval before being escalated to a reviewer",
    "Payment is authorised by a named approver before the case closes",
    "The Cashier completes the Physical Court File from electronic records after posting"
  ]
}

{
  "objective": "Intake new patients to the mental health care institute.",
  "trigger": "A family doctor telephones the secretarial office of the mental health care institute to register a new patient.",
  "owner_and_participants": {
    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "Family doctors",
      "Social-medical workers",
      "Physicians",
      "A psychiatrist",
      "Secretarial staff"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "Name and residence of the patient",
    "Full inquiry into the mental, health, and social state of the patient",
    "Standard checklist completed during the examination",
    "Personal notebook entries",
    "Dictation transcribed from physician meetings",
    "Medical file requested and received"
  ],
  "systems_involved": [
    "Information system storing patient records",
    "Printed registration forms",
    "Registration cards issued to the first and second intakers",
    "Letters sent to family doctors requesting copies of medical files"
  ],
  "current_process": [
    "A family doctor telephones the secretarial office of the mental health care institute to register a new patient",
    "The secretarial worker inquires after the name and residence of the patient",
    "On the basis of this information, the doctor is put through to the nursing officer responsible for the part of the region that the patient lives in",
    "The nursing officer makes a full inquiry into the mental, health, and social state of the patient and records this on a registration form",
    "At the end of the conversation, the form is handed in at the secretarial office of the institute",
    "Here, the information on the form is stored in the information system and subsequently printed",
    "For new patients, a patient file is created",
    "Two registration cards are produced for respectively the future first and second intaker of the patient",
    "The first intaker plans a meeting with the patient as soon as this is possible",
    "During the first meeting, the patient is examined using a standard checklist which is filled out",
    "Additional observations are registered in a personal notebook",
    "After a visit, the first intaker puts a copy of these notes in the file of a patient",
    "The second intaker plans the first meeting only after the medical information of the physician if required has been received",
    "Physicians use dictaphones to record their observations made during meetings with patients",
    "The secretarial office types out these tapes, after which the information is added to the patient file",
    "As soon as the meetings of the first and second intaker with the patient have taken place, the secretarial office puts the patient on the list of patients that reach this status",
    "For the staff meeting on Wednesday, the team-leader is provided with a list of these patients"
  ],
  "bottlenecks_and_risks": [
    "Assigning intakers without taking into account expertise, region responsibility, earlier contacts, and case load means some patients receive no intake at all while others get more than one",
    "Printing the registration form and then storing it in the information system creates duplicate records and slows down access",
    "The first intaker keeps the registration with him at times when visiting the patient and in his close proximity when he is at the office, so there is no centralised record of the intake",
    "The second intaker does not meet until the medical information of the physician has arrived, so the intake is incomplete before the treatment plan is written",
    "Sending letters to family doctors requesting copies of medical files requires the secretary to contact them twice, once to request and once to confirm receipt",
    "Adding a copy of the file to the patient file only after the physician has confirmed it adds unnecessary delay between intake and treatment planning",
    "No defined exit point exists beyond putting the patient on the list of patients that reach this status, so the intake loop continues indefinitely"
  ],
  "recommended_improved_process": [
    "Define intake roles and responsibilities against expertise, region and previous contacts",
    "Record intake decisions automatically from the family doctor's notice, removing the need to phone",
    "Generate the assignment list directly from the intake decision, eliminating the paper list",
    "Store intake records centrally in the information system with a unique intake reference per patient",
    "Issue the first and second intaker cards electronically instead of printing",
    "Send the family doctor a confirmation message immediately after the intake completes",
    "Add the file copy to the patient file automatically upon receipt, rather than waiting for the physician",
    "Set a defined exit point - completion of the treatment plan or discharge",
    "Review intake performance monthly by region and role"
  ],
  "ai_agent_steps": [
    "An AI agent can generate the assignment list from the intake decision and the team leader's roster",
    "An AI agent can issue the first and second intaker cards and send the confirmation messages",
    "An AI agent can flag patients whose intake was incomplete because the file was not received",
    "An AI agent can produce the monthly intake report by region and role showing completion rate and average wait time"
  ],
  "human_approvals_controls": [
    "The team leader approves the assignment list before it is distributed to the intakers",
    "The physician confirms the medical file before it is added to the patient file",
    "Any change to the intake decision requires approval by the team leader",
    "Discharge or transfer of a patient requires the attending psychiatrist's signature"
  ]
}

{
  "objective": "Request and manage office supply purchases at an organization.",
  "trigger": "An employee submits an office supply request",
  "owner_and_participants": {
    "owner": "Not specified in input",
    "participants": [
      "Immediate supervisors of employees submitting requests",
      "Purchase department"
    ]
  },
  "inputs_data_required": [
    "Office supply requirements submitted by the employee",
    "Comments on changes requested by the supervisor",
    "Vendor selection decisions made by the purchase department"
  ],
  "systems_involved": [
    "A purchasing system generating purchase orders and sending notifications",
    "A database holding supplier information"
  ],
  "current_process": [
    "An employee submits an office supply request",
    "The request is received by the immediate supervisor of the employee",
    "The supervisor approves, asks for a change, rejects or does nothing",
    "If rejected, the process ends; if changed, the request returns to the employee to review the comments",
    "If approved, the purchase department quotes from suppliers using a subprocess",
    "From the quotation, the purchase department selects a vendor and confirms it",
    "Once a vendor is selected and confirmed, the system generates and sends a purchase order and waits for delivery and receipt of the invoice",
    "After the invoice arrives, the system sends a notification letting the user know the outcome"
  ],
  "bottlenecks_and_risks": [
    "Approval, rejection or change requires a person's decision, so there is no automated way to escalate or re-route a request",
    "Supervisors do not always respond promptly, which means some requests sit unacknowledged while others move through quickly",
    "Supplier selection depends entirely on the purchase department choosing one from a list of existing vendors, so the choice cannot be evaluated against value",
    "Confirmation of a chosen vendor requires another decision, so the same delay applies twice",
    "Invoices arrive after the purchase order has been sent, so the customer record is incomplete before payment",
    "No exception handling is defined for rejected or cancelled requests"
  ],
  "recommended_improved_process": [
    "Replace the paper-based approval route with electronic approval requiring a supervisor's sign-off",
    "Allow the purchaser to quote and select a vendor automatically from a shortlist of preferred suppliers",
    "Evaluate each proposed vendor against value criteria such as price, service and availability",
    "Confirm the vendor once the purchase order is issued, not during delivery",
    "Capture invoice arrival status directly from the supplier, removing the gap between order and payment",
    "Notify the requester immediately of the outcome, whether accepted, rejected, changed or cancelled"
  ],
  "ai_agent_steps": [
    "An AI agent can draft the purchase order from the supplier selection and confirm the vendor",
    "An AI agent can flag rejected or cancelled requests for escalation to a named approver",
    "An AI agent can compare the proposed vendor against the value criteria and suggest alternatives",
    "An AI agent can track invoices arriving late and notify the requester before payment"
